info.title: MedexRegAI fda-data API
info.description: Public FDA device data (openFDA 510(k), classification, recall, GUDID, MAUDE counts) held in its own database. Service-to-service only: send X-Api-Key. Responses carry a weak ETag; send If-None-Match to get 304.
